verdict.rationale: Plausible auto-tracks pageviews and scroll depth with no code, and offers no-code goal tracking for file downloads, form completions, and outbound link clicks via the dashboard toggle. However, click tracking beyond outbound links and generic form interactions may still require custom event snippets or the Events API rather than being fully automatic, and one community comment notes founders resist deeper user-flow tracking. Missing for 10: clear evidence that arbitrary clicks and all form interactions are captured with zero code (vs. relying on the Events API/custom events for many cases), and independent hands-on confirmation of the no-code goal setup working reliably.
